status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 31% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah and Binah.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 31 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah og Binah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces have intensified operations in the Kataib Hezbollah strongholds of Jurf al-Sakhar and Jurf al-Nasr, while Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered an inquiry into oil smuggling and threatened force to enforce a militia withdrawal deadline. Iran’s top IRGC commander arrived in Iraq for talks amid tensions with Kataib Hezbollah, and reports suggest Iran may be planning a dirty bomb attack in the US. Jordan and Iraq jointly blocked Telegram over national security and regulatory concerns, and the US consulate is conducting security tests in Erbil. Baghdad and Iran reached a deal for Kataib Hezbollah to leave Jurf al-Sakhar, and a former hostage said she was held in a militia stronghold targeted by the prime minister. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker har intensivert operasjoner i Kataib Hezbollas festningsområder Jurf al-Sakhar og Jurf al-Nasr, mens statsminister Al-Zaidi beordret en etterforskning av oljesmugling og truet med makt for å håndheve en frist for militær tilbaketrekning. Irans øverste IRGC-kommandør ankom Irak for samtaler midt i spenninger med Kataib Hezbollah, og rapporter antyder at Iran kan planlegge et skittent bombetiltak i USA. Jordan og Irak blokkerte i fellesskap Telegram av nasjonale sikkerhets‑ og reguleringshensyn, og den amerikanske konsuleringen gjennomfører sikkerhetstester i Erbil. Bagdad og Iran nådde en avtale om at Kataib Hezbollah skal forlate Jurf al-Sakhar, og en tidligere gissel sa at hun ble holdt i en militær festning som ble målrettet av statsministeren. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
